papers.title: The therapeutic effects of total hip arthroplasty with Zweymüller system for developmental dysplasia of the hip
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, the First Affiliated Hospital to Guangxi Medical University, Nanning 530021, China

corresponding_authors.name: Liangjun Zhao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, the First Affiliated Hospital to Guangxi Medical University, Nanning 530021, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于发育性髋关节发育不良的全髋关节置换术临床疗效，未涉及生物力学建模或应力分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes of THA with Zweymüller system for DDH, but contains no biomechanical analysis, no FEA, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion measurement, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Zweymüller系统在发育性髋关节发育不良全髋置换中的疗效。
summary_zh.result: 报告了该系统的临床效果和并发症。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访和影像学评估。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the therapeutic effects of total hip arthroplasty using the Zweymüller system for developmental dysplasia of the hip.
summary_en.method: Retrospective clinical case analysis of patients undergoing THA with the Zweymüller implant.
summary_en.result: The study reports clinical outcomes, including functional scores and complication rates.
